notes: Produced comprehensive pre-Phase 4 architecture and SOLID review (452 lines) synthesizing three perspectives: manual analysis of all 50+ source files, world-review subagent (UX/robustness), and solid-review-g31 subagent (SOLID/architecture). Included file-by-file assessment appendix covering all modules.
